chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch. 206 – The Flood Dragon Evolves
chapter_meta_description: The Flood Dragon evolves to the second tier, killing several sect disciples. Trapped underground, Han Li must form an uneasy alliance with a Core Formation cultivator to survive.
